create   TRIGGER ManageDeleteAccTree
ON tblAccTree 
/*WITH ENCRYPTION*/
FOR DELETE
AS
Declare @ID as  numeric(28,0)
Declare @AccCode as nvarchar(200)
Declare @AccParentCode as nvarchar(200)
Declare @ClientsAccCode as nvarchar(200)
Declare @SuppliersAccCode as nvarchar(200)
Declare @SafeAccCode as nvarchar(200)
Declare @ParentLen as int
declare @CompCode as int
--

Declare CurManageDeleteAccTree Cursor For Select AccCode , AccParent , CompCode from Deleted
Open CurManageDeleteAccTree
Fetch Next from CurManageDeleteAccTree into @AccParentCode, @AccCode,@CompCode
While @@Fetch_Status = 0 
Begin

	Select @ParentLen = SubsDigits-Len(AccCode) from tblAccTree Where AccCode = @AccParentCode

	Select @ID = right(@AccCode,@ParentLen)

	if exists(select ClientsAccCode From tblGeneralOptions Where OptionID = 0)
	Begin 
		Select @ClientsAccCode = ClientsAccCode From tblGeneralOptions Where OptionID = 0
		IF @AccParentCode = @ClientsAccCode -- The inserted Account is For Client then we Insert it's data to the Clients Table
		Begin 
			Alter Table [tblClients] Disable Trigger ManageDeleteClient
			Delete from [tblClients] Where ClientID = @ID
			Alter Table [tblClients] Enable Trigger ManageDeleteClient
		End
	End
	Else if exists(select SuppliersAccCode From tblGeneralOptions Where OptionID = 0)
	Begin 
		Select @SuppliersAccCode = SuppliersAccCode From tblGeneralOptions Where OptionID = 0
		IF @AccParentCode = @SuppliersAccCode -- The inserted Account is For Supplier then we Insert it's data to the Suppliers Table
		Begin
			Alter Table [tblSuppliers] Disable Trigger ManageDeleteSupplier
			Delete from tblSuppliers Where SupplierID = @ID
			Alter Table [tblSuppliers] Enable Trigger ManageDeleteSupplier
		End
	End

	Fetch Next from CurManageDeleteAccTree into @AccParentCode, @AccCode,@CompCode

End
Close CurManageDeleteAccTree
Deallocate CurManageDeleteAccTree

create TRIGGER trgInventoryDelete
ON tblInventory 
/*WITH ENCRYPTION*/
FOR DELETE 
AS

DECLARE @ID as numeric(28,0)
DECLARE @ProductID as numeric(28,0)
DECLARE @StoreID as numeric(28,0)
DECLARE @CompCode as int
DECLARE @InvoiceDate as smalldatetime
DECLARE @OutQty numeric(20,5)
DECLARE @OutBonus numeric(20,5)
DECLARE @InQty numeric(20,5)
DECLARE @InBonus numeric(20,5)


BEGIN TRANSACTION

Alter Table tblInventory Disable Trigger trgInventoryUpdate

Declare CurDeleteInventoryTransaction Cursor 
For Select [ID],ProductID,StoreID,CompCode,InvoiceDate,OutQuantity,OutBonus,InQuantity,InBonus From DELETED
Open CurDeleteInventoryTransaction
Fetch Next From CurDeleteInventoryTransaction INTO @ID,@ProductID,@StoreID,@CompCode,@InvoiceDate,@OutQty,@OutBonus,@InQty,@InBonus
While @@Fetch_Status = 0 
Begin
	
	UPDATE tblInventory SET [StorePurchaseStock] = StorePurchaseStock-@InQty+@OutQty , [StoreBonusStock] = StoreBonusStock-@InBonus+@OutBonus,[StoreProductStock]=StoreProductStock-@InQty+@OutQty-@InBonus+@OutBonus 
	Where 
	([ProductID] = @ProductID AND [StoreID] = @StoreID AND CompCode = @CompCode AND [InvoiceDate] = @InvoiceDate AND [ID] > @ID ) OR 
	([ProductID] = @ProductID AND [StoreID] = @StoreID AND CompCode = @CompCode  AND [InvoiceDate] > @InvoiceDate)
	
	UPDATE tblInventory SET [TotalInventoryQuantity] = TotalInventoryQuantity-@InQty+@OutQty , [TotalInventoryBonus] = TotalInventoryBonus-@InBonus+@OutBonus,[TotalInventory]=TotalInventory-@InQty+@OutQty-@InBonus+@OutBonus 
	Where 
	([ProductID] = @ProductID AND CompCode = @CompCode  AND [InvoiceDate] = @InvoiceDate AND [ID] > @ID ) OR 
	([ProductID] = @ProductID AND CompCode = @CompCode AND [InvoiceDate] > @InvoiceDate)
	
	--Update Product Stock 
	UPDATE [tblProducts]
	set 
	PurchasedStock = PurchasedStock-@InQty+@OutQty ,
	BonusStock = BonusStock-@InBonus+@OutBonus,
	ProductStock = ProductStock-@InQty+@OutQty-@InBonus+@OutBonus 
	where 
	ProductID = @ProductID AND 
	CompCode = @CompCode 
	
	--Update Product Stock in Store 
	UPDATE [tblProductsStores]
	SET 
	[PurchasedStock]=PurchasedStock-@InQty+@OutQty,
	[BonusStock]= BonusStock-@InBonus+@OutBonus,
	[ProductStock]=ProductStock-@InQty+@OutQty-@InBonus+@OutBonus 
	WHERE 
	[ProductID]=@ProductID And 
	[StoreID]=@StoreID AND 
	CompCode = @CompCode 

	Fetch Next From CurDeleteInventoryTransaction INTO @ID,@ProductID,@StoreID,@CompCode,@InvoiceDate,@OutQty,@OutBonus,@InQty,@InBonus

End
CLOSE CurDeleteInventoryTransaction
DEALLOCATE CurDeleteInventoryTransaction


IF @@ERROR > 0 
BEGIN
	ROLLBACK
	GOTO ReEnableTrigger
END
ELSE 
BEGIN
	COMMIT
	GOTO ReEnableTrigger
END


ReEnableTrigger:
Alter Table tblInventory Enable Trigger trgInventoryUpdate

/*WITH ENCRYPTION*/
FOR UPDATE
AS

Declare @OpenProQty numeric(20,5)

Declare @NewInBonus numeric(20,5)

Declare @ProductID numeric(28,0)

Declare @OldStoreID numeric(28,0)

Declare @NewInvDate  smalldatetime
Declare @OldInvDate  smalldatetime

Declare @RowGuid as uniqueidentifier
--
BEGIN TRANSACTION 
--

ALTER TABLE [tblInventory] NOCHECK CONSTRAINT [CK_tblInventory_StorePurchaseStock]
ALTER TABLE [tblInventory] NOCHECK CONSTRAINT [CK_tblInventory_StoreProductStock]

--ALTER TABLE [tblInventory] Disable Trigger trgInventoryUpdate

--
Declare CurInventoryUpdate Cursor For
SELECT 
[INSERTED].[ID],
[INSERTED].[ProductID],
[INSERTED].[CompCode],
[INSERTED].[RowGuid],

[INSERTED].[StoreID],
cast([INSERTED].[InvoiceDate] as smalldatetime) ,
isnull([INSERTED].[InQuantity],0) ,
isnull([INSERTED].[InBonus],0) ,
isnull([INSERTED].[OutQuantity],0) ,
isnull([INSERTED].[OutBonus],0) ,

[DELETED].[StoreID],
cast([DELETED].[InvoiceDate] as smalldatetime) ,
isnull([DELETED].[InQuantity],0) ,
isnull([DELETED].[InBonus],0) ,
isnull([DELETED].[OutQuantity],0) ,
isnull([DELETED].[OutBonus],0)

FROM 
[INSERTED] inner join 
[DELETED] ON
[INSERTED].[ID] = [DELETED].[ID]

Open CurInventoryUpdate

Fetch Next From CurInventoryUpdate into
@ID ,
@ProductID ,
@CompCode ,
@RowGuid,

@NewStoreID ,
@NewInvDate ,
@NewInQty ,
@NewInBonus ,
@NewOutQty ,
@NewOutBonus ,

@OldStoreID ,
@OldInvDate ,
@OldInQty ,
@OldInBonus ,
@OldOutQty ,
@OldOutBonus

While @@Fetch_Status = 0 
Begin
	--IF no changes fetch next 
	IF 
	@NewStoreID = @OldStoreID and 
	@NewInvDate = @OldInvDate and

	@NewInQty = @OldInQty and
	@NewInBonus = @OldInBonus and
	@NewOutQty = @OldOutQty and
	@NewOutBonus = @OldOutBonus

	Begin
		GoTo FetchNext
	End

--==============================================================================
--Manage Old Quantities

	UPDATE 
	tblInventory 
	SET 
	[StorePurchaseStock] = StorePurchaseStock-@OldInQty+@OldOutQty ,
	[StoreBonusStock] = StoreBonusStock-@OldInBonus+@OldOutBonus,
	[StoreProductStock]=StoreProductStock-@OldInQty+@OldOutQty-@OldInBonus+@OldOutBonus 
	Where 
	([ProductID] = @ProductID AND [StoreID] = @OldStoreID AND CompCode = @CompCode AND [InvoiceDate] = @OldInvDate AND [ID] > @ID ) OR 
	([ProductID] = @ProductID AND [StoreID] = @OldStoreID AND CompCode = @CompCode  AND [InvoiceDate] > @OldInvDate)
	
	UPDATE tblInventory SET 
	[TotalInventoryQuantity] = TotalInventoryQuantity-@OldInQty+@OldOutQty , 
	[TotalInventoryBonus] = TotalInventoryBonus-@OldInBonus+@OldOutBonus,
	[TotalInventory]=TotalInventory-@OldInQty+@OldOutQty-@OldInBonus+@OldOutBonus 
	Where 
	([ProductID] = @ProductID AND CompCode = @CompCode  AND [InvoiceDate] = @OldInvDate AND [ID] > @ID ) OR 
	([ProductID] = @ProductID AND CompCode = @CompCode AND [InvoiceDate] > @OldInvDate)
	
	--Update Product Stock 
	UPDATE [tblProducts]
	set 
	PurchasedStock = PurchasedStock-@OldInQty+@OldOutQty ,
	BonusStock = BonusStock-@OldInBonus+@OldOutBonus,
	ProductStock = ProductStock-@OldInQty+@OldOutQty-@OldInBonus+@OldOutBonus 
	where 
	ProductID = @ProductID AND 
	CompCode = @CompCode 
	
	--Update Product Stock in Store 
	UPDATE [tblProductsStores]
	SET 
	[PurchasedStock]=PurchasedStock-@OldInQty+@OldOutQty,
	[BonusStock]= BonusStock-@OldInBonus+@OldOutBonus,
	[ProductStock]=ProductStock-@OldInQty+@OldOutQty-@OldInBonus+@OldOutBonus 
	WHERE 
	[ProductID]=@ProductID And 
	[StoreID]=@OldStoreID AND 
	CompCode = @CompCode 


/*
--Reenalbe Constraints
ALTER TABLE [tblInventory] CHECK CONSTRAINT [CK_tblInventory_TotalInventoryQuantity]
ALTER TABLE [tblInventory] CHECK CONSTRAINT [CK_tblInventory_TotalInventory]
ALTER TABLE [tblInventory] CHECK CONSTRAINT [CK_tblInventory_StorePurchaseStock]
ALTER TABLE [tblInventory] CHECK CONSTRAINT [CK_tblInventory_StoreProductStock]
*/


--HANDLE NEW QUANTITIES
--Product Stock
IF NOT EXISTS (Select [ID] from tblInventory where ProductID = @ProductID and CompCode = @CompCode and (Invoicedate < @NewInvDate OR Invoicedate = @NewInvDate and [ID] < @ID))
Begin
	SELECT 
	@OpenProQty = [OpeningPurchasedStock],
	@OpenProBonus = [OpeningBonusStock],
	@OpenPro = [OpeningStock] 
	FROM 
	[dbo].[tblProducts] 
	WHERE 
	ProductID = @ProductID and 
	CompCode = @CompCode 
end
IF EXISTS (Select [ID] from tblInventory where  ProductID = @ProductID and CompCode = @CompCode and (Invoicedate < @NewInvDate OR Invoicedate = @NewInvDate and [ID] < @ID))
Begin
	select 
	@MaxDate = Max(InvoiceDate) 
	from tblInventory 
	where 
	ProductID = @ProductID and 
	CompCode = @CompCode and 
	(Invoicedate < @NewInvDate OR Invoicedate = @NewInvDate and [ID] < @ID)
	
	IF @MaxDate < @NewInvDate 
	Begin
		select @MaxId = Max([id]) from tblInventory 
		where 
		ProductID = @ProductID and 
		CompCode = @CompCode and 
		Invoicedate = @MaxDate
	End
	Else IF @MaxDate = @NewInvDate 
	Begin
		select @MaxId = Max([id]) from tblInventory 
		where 
		ProductID = @ProductID and 
		CompCode = @CompCode and 
		Invoicedate = @MaxDate and 
		[ID] < @ID
	End
	
	SELECT 
	@OpenProQty = TotalInventoryQuantity , 
	@OpenProBonus = TotalInventoryBonus , 
	@OpenPro = TotalInventory
	FROM 
	[dbo].[tblInventory] 
	WHERE 
	[ID] = @MaxId
end

	SELECT

	FROM 
	[dbo].[tblProductsStores] 
	WHERE 
	ProductId = @ProductID and 
	StoreID = @NewStoreID and 
	CompCode = @CompCode 
End
IF EXISTS (Select [ID] from tblInventory where  ProductID = @ProductID and CompCode = @CompCode and (Invoicedate < @NewInvDate OR Invoicedate = @NewInvDate and  [ID] < @ID) and StoreID = @NewStoreID)
Begin
	SELECT

	StoreID = @NewStoreID and 
	(Invoicedate < @NewInvDate OR Invoicedate = @NewInvDate and [ID] < @ID)
	
	IF @MaxDate < @NewInvDate

		from tblInventory 
		where 
		ProductID = @ProductID and 
		CompCode = @CompCode and 
		Invoicedate = @MaxDate and 
		[StoreID] = @NewStoreID 
	End
	Else IF @MaxDate = @NewInvDate 
	Begin
		SELECT
		@MaxId = Max([id]) 
		from tblInventory 
		where 
		ProductID = @ProductID and 
		CompCode = @CompCode and 
		Invoicedate = @MaxDate and 
		[StoreID] = @NewStoreID and

	End

	FROM [dbo].[tblInventory] 
	WHERE 
	[ID] = @MaxID

	SELECT @NewTotalInvQty = isnull(@OpenProQty + @NewInQty - @NewOutQty,0)
	SELECT @NewTotalInvBonus = isnull(@OpenProBonus + @NewInBonus - @NewOutBonus,0)

[TotalInventoryBonus]= @NewTotalInvBonus,
[TotalInventory]=@NewTotalInv,
[StorePurchaseStock]=@NewTotalStoreQty,

[TotalInventoryBonus] = TotalInventoryBonus+@NewInBonus-@NewOutBonus,
[TotalInventory]=TotalInventory+@NewInQty-@NewOutQty+@NewInBonus-@NewOutBonus 
Where

([ProductID] = @ProductID and [CompCode] = @CompCode and [StoreID] <> @NewStoreID and [InvoiceDate] > @NewInvDate)

--Update Product Stock

SET

ProductStock = ProductStock+@NewInQty-@NewOutQty+@NewInBonus-@NewOutBonus
WHERE

--Update Store Of serial numbers
IF @OldStoreID<>@NewStoreID
Begin

StoreID=@NewStoreID

inner join tblProductsSerialNumbersTrans PSNT on PSN.ProdSerialID=PSNT.ProdSerialID 
inner join tblInventory I ON I.RowGuid=PSNT.InventoryGuid
where

End

	GoTo FetchNext

Close CurInventoryUpdate

ON tblSalesOrderDetails
/*WITH ENCRYPTION*/
FOR Update

AS

Declare @NewDeliveredQuantity as Numeric(20,5)
Declare @OldDeliveredQuantity as Numeric(20,5)
Declare @DeliveredQuantity as Numeric(20,5)
Declare @SODetailsID as numeric(28,0)
Declare @ProductId as numeric(28,0)
Declare @SalesOrderID as numeric(28,0)
--
Declare CurSOD_Update Cursor For 
Select 
I.SODetailsID ,
I.SalesOrderID, 
I.ReservedQuantity ,
I.DeliveredQuantity,
D.DeliveredQuantity,
I.ProductID 
from 
Inserted I Inner Join 
Deleted D On 
I.SODetailsID = D.SODetailsID

Open CurSOD_Update

Fetch next from CurSOD_Update Into @SODetailsID , @SalesOrderID , @ReservedQuantity , @NewDeliveredQuantity , @OldDeliveredQuantity,@ProductID
While @@Fetch_Status  =  0
Begin
	--
	IF @ReservedQuantity <= @NewDeliveredQuantity 
	Begin
		Update tblSalesOrderDetails 
		Set 
		UnDeliveredQuantity = 0,
		Completed = 1 
		where 
		SODetailsID = @SODetailsID
	End
	Else IF @ReservedQuantity > @NewDeliveredQuantity 
	Begin
		Update tblSalesOrderDetails 
		Set 
		UnDeliveredQuantity = @ReservedQuantity - @NewDeliveredQuantity,
		Completed = 0 
		where 
		SODetailsID = @SODetailsID
	End
	--
	Exec spProductReservedQuantityUpdate @ProductID
	--
	IF Not Exists(Select SODetailsID From tblSalesOrderDetails Where SalesOrderID = @SalesOrderID and Completed = 0) 
	Begin
		Update tblSalesOrder Set Status = 3 Where SalesOrderID = @SalesOrderID
	End
	Else IF Not Exists(Select SODetailsID From tblSalesOrderDetails Where SalesOrderID = @SalesOrderID and DeliveredQuantity > 0)
	Begin
		Update tblSalesOrder Set Status = 1 Where SalesOrderID = @SalesOrderID
	End
	Else IF Exists(Select SODetailsID From tblSalesOrderDetails Where SalesOrderID = @SalesOrderID and DeliveredQuantity < ReservedQuantity)
	Begin
		Update tblSalesOrder Set Status = 2 Where SalesOrderID = @SalesOrderID
	End
	--
	Fetch next from CurSOD_Update Into @SODetailsID , @SalesOrderID , @ReservedQuantity , @NewDeliveredQuantity , @OldDeliveredQuantity, @ProductID
End
